lfpy.notes: LFPy is a Python package for simulating extracellular potentials (LFP). The entity files (lfpy.md, lfpykit.md) currently have no source papers. No candidate papers were provided for evaluation.

michael-hines.reason: All three papers are directly relevant - they cover the NEURON simulation environment which Michael Hines leads development of.

mni-space.reason: All three papers are relevant to MNI space and whole-brain modeling: statistical parametric mapping (Friston), connectomics (Smith, Sporns).

nancy-andrews-hanna.reason: All papers are about default mode network, aging, and functional connectivity - directly relevant to Andrews-Hanna's research focus. The damoiseaux-2008 paper specifically addresses DMN connectivity changes in aging.

nitin-gogtay.reason: gogtay-2004 is the landmark longitudinal MRI study on cortical development - directly relevant to Gogtay's work on developmental trajectories.
